name: Factory floor
desc: Where the work is loud and repetitive, and someone has been doing it for twenty years.
tags: factory floor, conveyor belt, overhead crane rail, steel gantry walkway, machine housings, pipework overhead, control panels, hanging work lamps, painted floor markings, stacked pallets, high wall windows
prose: a long factory floor lined with machinery and conveyor belts beneath a steel gantry, pipework and cable trays running overhead, painted safety markings across the concrete and hard work lamps hung above the line
note: Era is completely undefined by the word factory, so with no period cue you get an anonymous modern plant of grey boxes. Name the actual machinery - looms, presses, car bodies on a line, robot arms - because that noun is what sets the century. The high wall windows are the only route for daylight; leave them out and every daytime scene renders as night shift regardless of the grade.
